restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.claim: The restaurant asks guests with allergies to alert staff; its linked Toast catalog publishes item-level positive allergen labels for many products, but no exhaustive negative or cross-contact matrix was found.

summary: GrillMarX Columbia's official menus and linked Toast catalog confirm the Little Patuxent Parkway identity and 98 current products across main, raw-bar, gluten-free, and brunch service. All 140 frozen rows are reconciled; repeated priced, gluten-free, and modifier presentations are consolidated and navigation text is classified as artifact. Linked Toast provides direct positive allergen labels for many items, preserved here without treating unlabeled allergens as absent; no exhaustive matrix or cross-contact chart was found.
